escalations.title: Handlebars.js JavaScript Injection via AST Type Confusion
escalations.attack_vector: Malformed template syntax via jest → babel-jest → handlebars transitive chain
escalations.impact: Arbitrary code execution in test framework; can be triggered during CI test runs
escalations.fix: Upgrade jest to v30.0.0+ (removes babel-jest dependency on handlebars)

escalations.title: protobufjs Arbitrary Code Execution via Prototype Pollution
escalations.attack_vector: Craft protobuf schema with field names like __proto__ or constructor.prototype
escalations.impact: Remote code execution via observability/gRPC stack (OpenTelemetry, grpc-js) in portal/Backend and orchestrator
escalations.fix: Upgrade to protobufjs ≥7.7.0 via @opentelemetry/* major version upgrade

escalations.title: Vitest UI Server Arbitrary File Read/Execute
escalations.attack_vector: POST /api/execute?code=<payload> to Vitest UI server on port 51204 (default) — any network attacker
escalations.impact: Remote code execution on any developer machine running tests; CI runner compromise
escalations.fix: Upgrade vitest ≥3.2.6; disable UI server flag in CI/CD
